title: Gemma 3 Technical Report
blurb: Extends the Gemma decoder to 128k-token contexts by making most layers sliding-window attention, with a global layer every few layers.
intro: Gemma 3's block is a GQA decoder block with RMSNorm on both sides of each sublayer and QK-norm inside attention. The architecture change that matters most is the layer schedule: five local sliding-window layers for every global layer, with a small RoPE base for local layers and a large one for global layers. The steps cover sliding-window GQA, RoPE, the norm choices and the gated MLP; the capstone builds the interleaved stack.
